Presidential Gubernatorial Governor Dauda Lawal
The Zamfara State Chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) has constituted over 900-member Gubernatorial Campaign Council to coordinate and drive the party’s campaign activities towards the 2027 general elections. This was disclosed in a statement on Sunday by the Secretary to the State Government Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada who doubles as Secretary, Zamfara State APC Gubernatorial Campaign Council.
The constitution of the Council follows extensive consultations and recommendations by the State Chapter of the APC and was approved by Dauda Lawal, the Governor of Zamfara State and the leadership of the party in the State.
The Council will be chaired by Governor Lawal, with Mani Mummuni the Deputy Governor of the State and Hon Kabiru Moyi B Magaji, the State APC Chairman serving as Vice Chairmen respectively.
Elder statesman Salihu Maibuhu Gummi will serve as Director-General of the Council, while Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada the Secretary to the State Government, will serve as Secretary-General.
Dr Sani Ahmad Sambo will serve as the Spokesperson of the Council.
The Council is mandated to coordinate and drive the APC’s campaign activities in the state towards securing a resounding victory for the APC in the forthcoming election.
In line with the Party’s commitment to issue-based campaigns, the Council will focus on showcasing the achievements of the administration over the past three years.

All members were urged to demonstrate commitment, unity, discipline and dedication to the collective success of the party, while ensuring strict compliance with the provisions of the Electoral Act and the guidelines of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC).
